thread:
Noah Rivera: Heads up — BlueHarbor (trial) usage dropped by 60% after week 2. Renewal touchpoint in 10 days. I'm worried they might churn instead of converting. Thoughts on a short rescue play?

Priya Shah: Oof. Can we run a quick gap analysis first? Which flows are failing: ingestion, prompt templates, or infra limits?

Ethan Wu: From logs it looks like the ingestion pipeline spiked errors last Wed and they never fully recovered. Putting a temporary throttled plan doesn't help if data isn't flowing. Need a short triage + hands-on fix.

Claire Liu: Suggest a 14-day "keepalive" bundle: 2x 60-min paired sessions (engineering + CSM), 5000 free API tokens, and a rollback guarantee so they can test without risk. Keep language simple.

Noah Rivera: Love it. Make the success window 14 days and define 2 measurable goals: (1) pipeline error rate <1% for 48h, (2) 3 active teammates running production prompts daily. If both met, we auto-mark for conversion assist.

Priya Shah: Also require a one-page runbook from their engineers after session 1 documenting ingestion fixes. That helps AE/Support escalate if issues repeat.

Ethan Wu: Technical checklist I can bring to session:
```
- verify webhook auth and retries
- check batching config (batch_size, timeout)
- inspect error logs for 429/5xx patterns
- enable debug mode for 48 hours and forward aggregated logs to us
```

onboarding-bot: Task created: CS-4012 1 - BlueHarbor keepalive bundle. Assignee: Claire Liu. Link: https://redwood/tasks/CS-4012

Claire Liu: Draft outreach I can send: "We noticed your integration hit a hiccup. Would two short paired sessions + temporary tokens and rollback help you validate fixes quickly? Here's a scheduling link: <cal.link/blueharbor>"

Noah Rivera: Add the 2-question feedback survey we use for rescues (short so they answer): 1) What blocked value for you? 2) After the session, what's the one thing that would make this successful?

Priya Shah: For Finance/AE: prefer to grant tokens rather than discounts. @AE-team can we earmark 5k tokens for CS-4012?

Ethan Wu: Ops ask: Let's record the session and save the runbook in account docs. If they fail to meet metrics after 14 days we trigger a follow-up play: extend bundle once (14d) or propose downgrade to Lite with migration help.

Claire Liu: I'll add a migration snippet to the outreach: "If you prefer to pause heavy usage we can switch you to Lite temporarily and migrate you back once stable. We'll handle exports and a 7-day migration window."

Noah Rivera: Action items: 1) Claire send outreach + cal link, 2) Ethan prepare tech checklist & enable debug, 3) Priya confirm token allocation with AE, 4) Noah own renewal sync. I'll update CS-4012 with these notes and change urgency to P0.

Priya Shah: Quick note on tracking: Ill add two labels to the account: keepalive-active and conversion-candidate. If metrics hit, run a conversion workflow.

Ethan Wu: One final ask  can we include a short opt-in for a product manager to join the review? If the blocker is feature-related we can log it in roadmap with priority.

Claire Liu: Yes. I'll add PM-join as optional in the invite and attach the 2-question survey.

Noah Rivera: Thanks team 44d I'll run the sync with AE before outreach and post results here after the first session.
